headline: Discover Historical Sites
primaryText: Experience personalized attention and unforgettable memories on our guided tours.
whyItWorks: The oversized headline names the destination type in a few plain words, so a history-minded traveler knows at once whether it is for them. The photo of a wooden sailing boat off a rocky coast adds a sense of place and adventure that the text only hints at. The promise of personal attention sets a small guided tour apart from mass tourism, and the single Open button keeps the next step easy.
